reason: A mobile UI adaptation plugin for the DSH Web GUI that changes narrow-screen layouts into a full-screen chat interface with drawer navigation and mobile controls, while preserving the desktop layout at wider widths.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供窄屏移动端布局，将侧栏和右侧面板转换为抽屉并加入顶部操作栏与全屏导航。
summaries.en: Adapts the DSH Web GUI for narrow mobile screens by turning sidebars and panels into drawers and adding a top control bar with fullscreen navigation.

capabilities: Adapts the web interface for narrow screens
Converts sidebars and panels into mobile drawers
Adds mobile navigation controls and fullscreen behavior
Reads and writes local plugin settings
